Intel graphics on Windows work again, plus an early 3D mode for two phones and a few things that make the window easier to set up.

## New

- **3D** (Lab): two phones go out as one 3D picture on the Telescope camera, side by side or red/cyan. It lines the two up by when each frame was taken, and **Match** evens out their shutter, brightness and colour.
- **Reorder cards**: right-click a card's header, or open **Layout** in Settings > General, and drag cards up, down or over to the other side.
- **Reset** on every card puts it back to its defaults, and **Reset all settings** in Settings > General does the same for everything except your phones and presets.

## Fixed

- Intel graphics on Windows now run through DirectX 12 instead of Vulkan, whose Intel driver crashed while Telescope opened the card. Laptops that 5.1.2 moved to their other card after one crash now start without crashing at all.
- A graphics card that was skipped after a crash gets another try once its driver is updated.

## Changed

- On laptops with two graphics cards, Telescope uses the faster one unless you pick **Power saving** for it in Windows' graphics settings.
- Plugins can carry a **Lab** tag (an early version) or a **Limited** tag (has limits that won't go away, like Privacy blur).
